dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The deeper difference from the US is the BASE: this 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price, where the US charges its 41.4% (HTS 9405.11.80) on retail. About CA$2.04 a unit against US$40.57.
verdict: Priced at CA$74.99, CA$0.43 under the CA$75.42 amazon.ca band median and CA$11.74 under the CA$86.73 RULE 2 ceiling. Contributes CA$27.02/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) at C$32.58 with free freight, against the CA$16.23 floor. No promo gap on this variant. Per-SKU stock 1000 clears rule 4. Voltage 90-260 V and E27 on the listing the lantern already ships from. Rule 18: the only gourd in the range. Contributes CA$23.01/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) at the LIST cost of C$36.32, against the CA$16.23 floor - clears by CA$6.78. Rule 22: the page sells at C$34.14, a 6% gap under the C$36.32 originalPrice, so the LIST price is the cost basis and the sale price is upside the model does not count. Per-SKU stock 876 clears rule 4 (>= 25) by a wide margin; the 'Max. 20 pcs/shopper' on every SKU of this listing is a PER-ORDER cap, not a stock figure, and is not the one-unit cap that killed the old dome listing. Rule 18: a gourd - wider at the belly than the shoulder with a flat top - is not the saucer (wide brim), the dome, the straight lantern column, the slatted pear (which is strips over rings, not a close weave, and bulges the other way) or the stepped drum. Top competitor review count 255 in this basket, so the category is not locked.
